concept: DR strategies: Warm standby — scaled-down copy in another Region, RTO minutes
tests: Choosing a DR strategy: recover in another Region within minutes with minimal data loss, without full duplication.
expected: Warm standby: an always-running scaled-down copy in a second Region + continuous data replication; scales up during a disaster. Triggers: "within minutes", "minimal data loss", "avoid running full duplicate infrastructure".
why_not: Backup and restore — hours; Pilot light — slow scale-up (compute is off); Single-Region multi-AZ doesn't protect against a Region failure; Multi-site — full duplicate, expensive.
